questions.q: In 'The Serpent and the Eagle', what did the Serpent do when he could not bite the Countryman?
choices: Put poison into the Countryman's drinking horn
Wrapped himself tightly around the Countryman's neck
Hid inside the Countryman's bag to bite him later
Chased the Eagle far away from the Countryman
questions.evidence: he struck at the drinking horn

questions.q: In 'The Serpent and the Eagle', why did the Eagle take the horn from the Countryman?
choices: To save him from drinking the poison
Because the Eagle was thirsty too
To play a trick on the Countryman
Because the horn was shiny
questions.evidence: the Eagle seized the poisoned horn from out his savior's hands

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Serpent and the Eagle'?
choices: An act of kindness is well repaid
Never drink from a cold spring
Eagles are stronger than serpents
Always stay far away from snakes
questions.evidence: An act of kindness is well repaid.

The other Sheep found him out and chased him away
